**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user is in the process of buying a new home.
- [EVENT] The user has been house hunting for a while.
- [EVENT] The user fell in love with a 2-bedroom condo on February 15th.
- [FACT] The condo had amazing modern appliances and a community pool.
- [EVENT] The user's offer on the condo got rejected on February 17th due to a higher bid.
- [EVENT] The user is buying a 3-bedroom townhouse in the Brookside neighborhood.
- [TEMPORAL] The session date is 2023/03/08 (Wed) 12:16.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant expressed sympathy for the user's rejected offer and congratulated them on finding a new home.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant provided a comprehensive checklist for documents needed to finalize the deal on the new home, including:
  - Pre-Contract Documents: Purchase Agreement, Pre-approval Letter, Proof of Funds.
  - Due Diligence Documents: Home Inspection Report, Appraisal Report, Title Search and Insurance, Environmental Reports.
  - Loan Documents: Mortgage Application, Loan Estimate, Final Loan Disclosure, Mortgage Note.
  - Insurance and Warranty Documents: Homeowners Insurance Policy, Warranty Documents.
  - Closing Documents: Closing Disclosure, Deed, Title, Bill of Sale, Closing Statement.
  - Other Documents: Identification, Proof of Income, Bank Statements.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised the user to review each document carefully and keep digital copies for records.
- [USER] The user requested help to organize the documents by the timeline of the process.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant provided a suggested timeline for organizing the documents, including:
  - Pre-Contract: Pre-approval Letter, Proof of Funds.
  - Contract to Purchase: Purchase Agreement, Earnest Money.
  - Due Diligence: Home Inspection Report, Appraisal Report, Title Search and Insurance, Environmental Reports.
  - Loan Application and Processing: Mortgage Application, Loan Estimate, Final Loan Disclosure.
  - Insurance and Warranty: Homeowners Insurance Policy, Warranty Documents.
  - Closing Preparations: Closing Disclosure, Identification and Proof of Income, Bank Statements.
  - Closing: Deed, Title, Bill of Sale, Closing Statement, Loan Funding.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant noted that the timeline may vary depending on the complexity of the transaction and advised the user to stay in close communication with their lender and real estate agent.
- [USER] The user asked about the home inspection report and common issues found, as well as how to negotiate with the seller to fix them.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant listed common issues found in home inspection reports, including:
  - Roofing and Gutters: Damaged shingles, clogged gutters.
  - Plumbing: Leaks
